g.text: Complete technical sequence of the Groq LLM & Self-Healing execution cycle
Tech: Logic | Purpose: Identifies query objective
Tech: Context | Purpose: DB metadata loading
Tech: Synthesis | Purpose: Formats prompt with schema
Tech: Model | Purpose: LLM processing & coding
Tech: Output | Purpose: Extracts SQL text block
Tech: Security | Purpose: Verifies read-only statements
Tech: Healing | Purpose: Resolves syntax errors
Tech: Execution | Purpose: Runs query in PostgreSQL/MySQL/Oracle
Tech: Processing | Purpose: Formats output grid
Tech: Visuals | Purpose: Selects optimal visualization type
Tech: Summary | Purpose: Translates results to narrative
Tech: Export | Purpose: Converts report to files
